target_caveat: Trained and evaluated against GloFAS v4 reanalysis - a MODELLED product, not observed river data. Observed CWC gauge data will replace this when access is granted. Predictions are modelled discharge, never 'river levels'.

q_today_m3s.source: GloFAS v4 consolidated reanalysis via Open-Meteo Flood API (model reanalysis, NOT a gauge reading)

catchment_rain_24h_mm.source: Open-Meteo forecast product past hours (model analysis), mean of 4 bputra_guwahati catchment cells (CATCHMENT.md)

catchment_rain_48h_mm.source: Open-Meteo forecast product past hours (model analysis), mean of 4 bputra_guwahati catchment cells (CATCHMENT.md)

threshold_m3s.source: 90th percentile of 2015-2025 monsoon GloFAS reanalysis (elevated level, YELLOW tier; NOT an official danger level)

threshold_extreme_m3s.source: 98th percentile of 2015-2025 monsoon GloFAS reanalysis (extreme level, RED tier; NOT an official danger level)

q_m3s.source: JalDrishti model v0 for bputra_guwahati - shipped: trained_hgb, fitted on 2015-2025 GloFAS reanalysis (docs/MODEL-CARD-bputra_guwahati-v0.md); modelled discharge, NOT observed river levels

p_exceed_threshold.source: JalDrishti model v0 for bputra_guwahati - shipped: trained_hgb, fitted on 2015-2025 GloFAS reanalysis (docs/MODEL-CARD-bputra_guwahati-v0.md); modelled discharge, NOT observed river levels - P(exceed q90 elevated level) from held-out validation residuals

colour.source: decision rule on model v0 output: P(exceed q98 extreme) >= 0.5 RED, else P(exceed q90 elevated) >= 0.2 YELLOW, else GREEN (documented cutoffs, arbitrary)

basis_plain: A tested river model expects the Brahmaputra reach near here to stay in its normal range through tomorrow (river currently falling).
